summary_full: Founded in 2020 by Roger Daltrey and his family, Lakedown Brewing Co. is a charming microbrewery based in East Sussex. Dedicated to crafting easy-drinking beers from high-quality ingredients, they also oversee the Lakedown Trout Fishery, creating a picturesque setting for visitors. Committed to the local community, the brewery actively supports youth music training initiatives, with their beers available in many independent pubs around Sussex.
